message:
The other day, I found myself staring at my pantry, wondering if I could survive a winter storm with just a can of soup and some questionable-looking crackers. I decided to take a little inventory and, to my surprise, I also discovered a stash of canned beans and a bag of rice I had forgotten about. 

In that moment, I felt like I’d won the lottery — or at least a small prize in the preparedness game. It reminded me that sometimes, a little organization can go a long way in making us feel ready for whatever Mother Nature throws our way. 

So, have you checked your pantry lately? What’s your go-to tip for being storm-ready?
